cells.gaps: The strategy's period ended in 2025, before 2026, and no successor is on record in a dated evidence row. The nearest candidates are systems.csv lines only: a 'stratégie de l'économie numérique' said by UNESCO to be under preparation in June 2025, and later references to a 'stratégie nationale de transformation numérique' with no act, content or period; none is described as a national successor, so stage 2 for lapsed-with-successor is not reached. Adoption rests on a general ITU repository listing naming no act; no text, plan or reporting row is held. The donor finance row (GAB-005, AfDB, Nov 2020) is outside the 36-month window.
cells.note: Instrument: Plan national stratégique Gabon Digital 2025 (SGDN / Gabon-Digital), 2020-2025, read as adopted from the ITU listing (GAB-001) with its period ended (GAB-002). Lapsed with no successor on record is unplaced.
